player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: እቲ ምንቅስቓስ ብመልክዕ [macro micro] ካብ 0-8 ብዝተፈላለየ ቁጽሪ ክኸውን ኣለዎ።
invalid_move.out_of_range: ነፍሲ ወከፍ ኢንዴክስ ካብ 0 ክሳብ 8 ክኸውን ኣለዎ።
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: እቲ ማይክሮ_ቦርድ፡ ረድፊ ወይ ዓምዲ ካብ ክሊ ወጻኢ እዩ።
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: እቲ ተጻዋታይ ኣብ'ቲ ቀጺሉ ዘሎ ማይክሮ ቦርድ ክጻወት ኣለዎ።
invalid_move.micro_board_won: The micro board is already won.

outcome.win: ተጻዋታይ {player_id} ናይ መወዳእታ ቲክ ታክ ቱ ይዕወት!
